text:
alex: FYI PR #20765 CI microbench failed on aws-ci-kv-prefetch. Median latency up ~18% on kernel-selector path :grimacing:

maria: ugh. which metric tripped the threshold?

alex: threshold diff shows `batch_kernel_select.ms` +18% and `kv_hit_rate` dropped from 0.83 -> 0.57 in the CI run. link: https://ci.internal/perf/20765

praveen: CI bot posted the diffs earlier, pinging @jessie who merged the batching change

ci-bot: [perf-alert] test=ci-microbench/kvcache_prefetch median_latency +18% (> +10% threshold). Details: https://ci.internal/alerts/33012

jessie: I rolled a tiny batching heuristic tweak in that PR (reduce batch wait at seqlen 1-8). Didn't expect kv-hit to change. Investigating.

sam: can you paste the flamegraph or a quick grep of hot functions? I want to see if kernel selection shifted to slower kernel.

jessie: quick sampling:
```
hot functions:
- batcher::select_kernel (43%)
- kv_cache::handle_miss (27%)
- runtime::dispatch_slowpath (15%)
```
seems like more traffic hitting select_kernel slowpath

maria: maybe prefetch order changed and evicted warm prefixes. k.v. hit-rate drop suggests eviction. Any env diff between runs (seqlen distribution)?

alex: seqlen pct: prev run p50=20, current run p50=18. not huge. but our prefetch window was reduced to 2 in the tweak.

praveen: proposed bisect: revert batching tweak on CI and re-run microbench. if that brings hit-rate back, we revert and follow up with improved prefetch strategy.

jessie: starting revert run now: `ci-run --microbench kvcache_prefetch --commit HEAD~1` will post results

ci-bot: Started job #33045 for revert verification. ETA ~12m

alex: also adding an instrumentation patch to log kv-prefetch candidate counts and eviction counters, small PR in draft.

maria: action items: (1) wait for revert CI, (2) gather kv eviction/candidate logs from both runs, (3) if revert fixes, open revert PR and tag as rollout-blocker.

sam: if revert doesn't fix, we should bisect kernel selector changes next. I'll free a slot for bisect.

jessie: thanks all. will update thread when CI finishes :crossed_fingers:
